crossRefs.note: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

people.name: Jashub
people.line: Son of Issachar, grandson of Jacob

people.name: Shimron
people.line: Son of Issachar and progenitor of the Shimronites.
